Name: (CC) British Butterflies
Author: KBKuriations
Description:
Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26599]Eurasian Birds for Ornithologists' Guild[/url], I decided to add British butterflies to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1255]Custom Critters[/url].

Do. You. Know. HOW[i]FREAKING[b]MANY[/b][/i]KINDSOFBUTTERFLIESTHEUKHAS?﻿

The answer is [url=https://www.ukbutterflies.co.uk/taxonomy.php]a lot[/url]. Several species also have dimorphism between males and females, between spring and summer emergences, or just between locations/subspecies. So that species list is actually multiplied. It's very, very difficult to get a good distinction in a 16x16 sprite, but I did (except for the Glanville and heath fritillaries; those guys are identical so they share a sprite). I only did butterflies which are residents or migrants; I did not do species listed as questionable or adventive. In summer, there's also a small chance to see butterflies which are locally extinct in the British Isles but which are still common on the European mainland.

I'm just glad I didn't decide to do [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_butterflies_of_Texas]the butterflies of Texas[/url]. Yeesh.

Butterflies are divided by seasons, and by commonality/rarity. Each season (except winter) is comprised of a common folder, which spawns often all across the map, and a rare folder, which spawns rarely in more remote locations (think mountains, forest...basically [i]not town[/i]). The rare spawn list also contains a couple of common "spoilers" which will boost the numbers of the most common species and keep rare species rare (butterflies on the rare list move a bit faster, so if you see two of the same moving at different speeds, you know you didn't get a rare spawn once). Species distribution varies seasonally; a butterfly which is common in spring may be rare in summer, or vice versa, and absent the rest of the year. A few select species will spawn in town in winter (I know Pelican Town isn't really big enough for the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Urban_heat_island]urban heat island[/url] to really be in effect, but I needed a way to control where they spawn; imagine Gus turned on the boiler at the saloon and woke one up from hibernation or something). Butterflies in winter will be [i]slo~o~ow[/i] because it's cold! They also only spawn around midday because they really, really need that sun to be able to fly; mornings and evenings are just too cold even if the sun is still up. Summer butterflies will be a bit faster and more lively because of the heat, and will also continue to spawn later in the day in case you use a mod that delays summer sunsets.

There is also built-in support for locations added by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url], and butterflies will follow the same logic as elsewhere (rare butterflies only outside town, a few winter butterflies only in town). If you don't use all or any of those mods, don't worry; it won't harm your game. Just know that if you [i]do[/i] use them, you'll see some British butterflies around there as well. I kept spawn numbers reasonably low, both to avoid overwhelming smaller areas and as a nod to the fact that [url=https://butterfly-conservation.org/butterflies/the-state-of-britains-butterflies]the UK has lost many of its butterflies[/url] so while all species are represented, you may not see all of them every day in every place.

Installation is simple: just unzip into Mods/Custom Critters/Critters﻿ and enjoy alongside your other [CC] packs.

Version 1.1 fixes an error in which "winter" butterflies were in fact spawning in spring (leaving winter with [i]none[/i] instead of [i]few[/i]), slows the wing flapping animation in winter (previously, the travel speed was slower than other seasons but the wings beat at the same rate), and adds support for locations from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23468]Forager's Nooks and Cranies[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Mount Vapius[/url].
